1 --- 2 name: infographic-creator 3 description: 基于给定文字内容创建精美信息图。当用户请求创建信息图时使用。 4 --- 5 6 信息图（Infographic）将数据、信息与知识转化为可感知的视觉语言。它结合视觉设计与数据可视化，用直观符号压缩复杂信息，帮助受众快速理解并记住要点。 7 8 `Infographic = Information Structure + Visual Expression` 9 10 本任务使用 [AntV Infographic](https://infographic.antv.vision/) 创建可视化信息图。 11 12 在开始任务前，需要理解 AntV Infographic 语法规范，包括模板列表、数据结构、主题等。 13 14 ## 规范 15 16 ### AntV Infographic 语法 17 18 AntV Infographic 语法是一种自定义 DSL，用于描述信息图渲染配置。它使用缩进表达结构，适合 AI 直接生成并流式输出。核心信息包括： 19 20 1. template：用模板表达信息结构。 21 2. data：信息图数据，包含 `title`、`desc` 和主数据字段。 22 3. theme：主题配置，包含 `palette`、字体、风格化等。 23 24 例如： 25 26 ```infographic 27 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 28 data 29 title Title 30 desc Description 31 lists 32 - label Label 33 value 12.5 34 desc Explanation 35 icon document text 36 theme 37 palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316 38 ``` 39 40 ### 硬性语法规则 41 42 - 第一行必须是 `infographic `。 43 - 模板列表里只写模板名本身；真正输出时首行必须显式写出 `infographic` 前缀。 44 - 使用 `data` / `theme` 块，块内统一使用两个空格缩进。 45 - 键值对写法是 `键 空格 值`；对象数组使用 `-` 作为条目前缀。 46 - `icon` 使用图标关键词，例如 `star fill`、`mingcute/server-line`。 47 - `value` 尽量使用纯数值；数值单位优先放在 `label` 或 `desc` 中表达。 48 - `palette` 推荐使用行内简单数组写法，例如 `palette #4f46e5 #06b6d4 #10b981`。 49 - `palette` 中的颜色值是裸值，不加引号，不加逗号。 50 - `data` 只放一个与模板匹配的主数据字段，避免同时混用 `lists`、`sequences`、`compares`、`values`、`root`、`nodes`。 51 52 主数据字段选择规则： 53 54 - `list-*` → `lists` 55 - `sequence-*` → `sequences`，可选 `order asc|desc` 56 - `sequence-interaction-*` → `sequences` + `relations` 57 - `sequences` 表示泳道列表 58 - 每个泳道必须包含 `label` 59 - 每个泳道的 `children` 表示节点列表 60 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 61 - 节点可选 `id`、`icon`、`step`、`desc`、`value` 62 - `step` 用于表示时间层级；相同 `step` 处于同一高度 63 - `compare-*` → `compares` 64 - `compare-binary-*` / `compare-hierarchy-left-right-*` 65 - `compares` 第一层必须且只能有两个根节点，分别表示对比双方 66 - 两个根节点都应包含 `children` 67 - 真正的对比项写在各自的 `children` 下 68 - `children` 下的每一项都必须写成对象条目，并包含 `label` 69 - 即使每一侧只有 1 个指标，也要写成 `children` 内含 1 个对象条目 70 - `compare-swot` 71 - `compares` 可直接放多个根节点 72 - 每个根节点下可选 `children` 73 - `compare-quadrant-*` 74 - `compares` 直接放 4 个象限根节点 75 - `hierarchy-structure` → `items` 76 - `hierarchy-*` → 单一 `root`，通过 `children` 递归嵌套 77 - `relation-*` → `nodes` + `relations` 78 - 简单关系也可直接用箭头语法表达关系 79 - `chart-*` → `values` 80 - `chart-line-plain-text` / `chart-bar-plain-text` / `chart-column-simple` 都使用单条有序 `values` 81 - 每个数据点使用 `label` 表示类目，使用 `value` 表示数值 82 - 折线图的顺序由 `values` 中条目的排列顺序表达 83 - 结构无法明确判断时，再用 `items` 兜底 84 85 主题规则： 86 87 - `theme` 用于自定义主题，例如 `palette`、`base`、`stylize` 88 - 使用 `theme.base.text.font-family` 指定字体，如 `851tegakizatsu` 89 - 使用 `theme.stylize` 选择内置风格并传参 90 - `rough`：手绘效果 91 - `pattern`：图案填充 92 - `linear-gradient` / `radial-gradient`：渐变风格 93 - 仅输出 Infographic 语法本身，不输出 JSON、解释性文字或额外 Markdown 段落 94 95 ## 数据语法示例 96 97 按模板类别给出精简但完整的正向示例： 98 99 - `list-*` 模板 100 101 ```infographic 102 infographic list-grid-badge-card 103 data 104 title Feature List 105 lists 106 - label Fast 107 icon flash fast 108 - label Secure 109 icon shield check 110 ``` 111 112 - `sequence-*` 模板 113 114 ```infographic 115 infographic sequence-ascending-steps 116 data 117 title 发布流程 118 sequences 119 - label 需求确认 120 - label 开发实现 121 - label 发布上线 122 order asc 123 ``` 124 125 - `sequence-interaction-*` 模板 126 127 ```infographic 128 infographic sequence-interaction-compact-animated-badge-card 129 data 130 title 登录校验流程 131 sequences 132 - label 用户 133 children 134 - label 发起登录 135 id user-login 136 step 0 137 - label 收到结果 138 id user-result 139 step 2 140 - label 服务端 141 children 142 - label 校验凭证 143 id server-verify 144 step 1 145 - label 返回结果 146 id server-return 147 step 2 148 relations 149 user-login - 提交账号密码 -> server-verify 150 server-verify - 生成结果 -> server-return 151 server-return - 返回结果 -> user-result 152 ``` 153 154 - `hierarchy-*` 模板 155 156 ```infographic 157 infographic hierarchy-tree-curved-line-rounded-rect-node 158 data 159 title 组织结构 160 root 161 label 公司 162 children 163 - label 产品部 164 - label 技术部 165 ``` 166 167 - `compare-swot` 模板 168 169 ```infographic 170 infographic compare-swot 171 data 172 title 产品 SWOT 173 compares 174 - label Strengths 175 children 176 - label 品牌认知高 177 - label Weaknesses 178 children 179 - label 成本压力大 180 ``` 181 182 - `compare-binary-*` 模板 183 184 ```infographic 185 infographic compare-binary-horizontal-simple-fold 186 data 187 title 餐桌价格对比 188 compares 189 - label 原价 190 children 191 - label 原价 192 value 500 193 icon tag 194 - label 实际支付 195 children 196 - label 实际支付 197 value 450 198 icon check bold 199 ``` 200 201 - `compare-quadrant-*` 模板 202 203 ```infographic 204 infographic compare-quadrant-quarter-simple-card 205 data 206 title 任务优先级 207 compares 208 - label 高价值低成本 209 - label 高价值高成本 210 - label 低价值低成本 211 - label 低价值高成本 212 ``` 213 214 - `chart-line-plain-text` 模板 215 216 ```infographic 217 infographic chart-line-plain-text 218 data 219 title 模型 A 准确率变化 220 desc 第 4 周提升最明显 221 values 222 - label Week1 223 value 86.5 224 - label Week2 225 value 87.3 226 - label Week3 227 value 89.1 228 - label Week4 229 value 91.2 230 theme 231 palette #4f46e5 #db2777 #14b8a6 232 ``` 233 234 - `relation-*` 模板 235 236 ```infographic 237 infographic relation-dagre-flow-tb-simple-circle-node 238 data 239 title 系统关系 240 nodes 241 - label API 242 - id db 243 label DB 244 relations 245 API - 读写 -> db 246 ``` 247 248 - 兜底 `items` 示例 249 250 ```infographic 251 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 252 data 253 title 要点总结 254 items 255 - label 效率优先 256 desc 聚焦关键动作 257 - label 结果导向 258 desc 输出可执行结论 259 ``` 260 261 ### 可用模板 262 263 - chart-bar-plain-text 264 - chart-column-simple 265 - chart-line-plain-text 266 - chart-pie-compact-card 267 - chart-pie-donut-pill-badge 268 - chart-pie-donut-plain-text 269 - chart-pie-plain-text 270 - chart-wordcloud 271 - compare-binary-horizontal-badge-card-arrow 272 - compare-binary-horizontal-simple-fold 273 - compare-binary-horizontal-underline-text-vs 274 - compare-hierarchy-left-right-circle-node-pill-badge 275 - compare-quadrant-quarter-circular 276 - compare-quadrant-quarter-simple-card 277 - compare-swot 278 - sequence-interaction-default-animated-badge-card 325 - sequence-interaction-default-compact-card 326 - sequence-interaction-default-capsule-item 327 - sequence-interaction-default-rounded-rect-node 328 329 ## 模板选择建议 330 331 - 严格顺序、步骤推进、阶段演进 → `sequence-*` 332 - 多角色或多系统交互 → `sequence-interaction-*` 333 - 并列要点列举 → `list-row-*` / `list-column-*` / `list-grid-*` 334 - 双方对比、方案对比、前后对比 → `compare-binary-*` 335 - 先确定双方是谁 336 - 再为双方分别展开 `children` 337 - SWOT 分析 → `compare-swot` 338 - 象限分析 → `compare-quadrant-*` 339 - 层级树结构 → `hierarchy-tree-*` 340 - 统计趋势、单条序列变化 → `chart-line-plain-text` 341 - 统计对比、单组数值比较 → `chart-bar-plain-text` / `chart-column-simple` 342 - 节点关系、流程依赖 → `relation-*` 343 - 词频主题展示 → `chart-wordcloud` 344 - 思维导图 → `hierarchy-mindmap-*` 345 346 ### 完整输出示例 347 348 ```infographic 349 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 350 data 351 title 产品增长要点 352 desc 聚焦获客、转化、复购三个阶段 353 lists 354 - label 获客 355 desc 多渠道投放与内容触达 356 icon rocket launch 357 - label 转化 358 desc 优化路径并减少流失 359 icon chart line 360 - label 复购 361 desc 会员权益与分层运营 362 icon repeat 363 theme 364 palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316 365 ``` 366 367 ## 输出格式 368 369 只输出一个 `plain` 代码块，不添加任何解释性文字： 370 371 ```infographic 372 infographic list-row-horizontal-icon-arrow 373 data 374 title 标题 375 desc 描述 376 lists 377 - label 条目 378 value 12.5 379 desc 说明 380 icon document text 381 theme 382 palette #3b82f6 #8b5cf6 #f97316 383 ``` 384 385 ## 自检清单 386 387 输出前检查以下事项： 388 389 - 首行是否为 `infographic ` 390 - 是否只使用了一个与模板匹配的主数据字段 391 - `palette` 是否为裸颜色值，且没有引号和逗号 392 - `sequence-interaction-*` 的泳道节点是否都写成 `children -> - label ...` 393 - `compare-binary-*` / `compare-hierarchy-left-right-*` 是否只有两个根节点，且两侧内容都放在各自的 `children` 下 394 - `children` 下的每一项是否都显式包含 `label` 395 - `chart-line-plain-text` 是否使用单条有序 `values` 396 - 输出中是否没有 JSON、解释文字或多余代码块 397 398 ## 生成流程 399 400 ### 第一步：理解用户需求 401 402 在创建信息图之前，先理解用户需求与想表达的信息，以便确定模板和数据结构。 403 404 若用户提供清晰的内容描述，应将其拆解为清晰、简洁的结构。 405 406 否则需要向用户澄清（如：“请提供清晰简洁的内容描述。”、“你希望使用哪个模板？”） 407 408 - 提取关键信息结构（title、desc、items 等）。 409 - 明确所需数据字段（title、desc、items、label、value、icon 等）。 410 - 选择合适模板。 411 - 使用 AntV Infographic 语法描述信息图内容 `{syntax}`。 412 413 **关键注意**：必须尊重用户输入的语言。例如用户输入中文，则语法中的文本也必须是中文。 414 415 ### 第二步：渲染信息图 416 417 当得到最终的 AntV Infographic 语法后，可按以下步骤生成完整 HTML 文件： 418 419 1. 创建包含以下结构的完整 HTML 文件： 420 - 1	# Aider LLM Polyglot Coding Leaderboard 2025
     2	
     3	## What Is This Benchmark?
     4	
     5	Aider is an AI pair-programming tool that runs in the terminal. To evaluate which large language models (LLMs) are best at autonomous code editing, Aider maintains a **polyglot coding leaderboard**. The benchmark tests each model on **225 challenging Exercism coding exercises** spanning **six programming languages**: C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust. Models must follow instructions and produce correct code edits without any human intervention.
     6	
     7	The primary metric is **percent correct** — the share of exercises where the model's code passes all tests after two attempts. Secondary metrics include total cost per benchmark run, correct edit format rate (how reliably the model follows the required diff format), and qualitative indicators like syntax errors and exhausted context windows.
     8	
     9	## Top 15 Models — Ranked by Accuracy
    10	
    11	| Rank | Model | Percent Correct | Cost | Edit Format | Correct Format % |
    12	|------|-------|----------------|------|-------------|------------------|
    13	| 1 | GPT-5 (high) | 88.0% | $29.08 | diff | 91.6% |
    14	| 2 | GPT-5 (medium) | 86.7% | $17.69 | diff | 88.4% |
    15	| 3 | Claude 4.0 Opus | 85.3% | $22.14 | diff-fenced | 97.3% |
    16	| 4 | Claude 4.0 Sonnet | 84.0% | $9.47 | diff-fenced | 96.9% |
    17	| 5 | Gemini 2.5 Pro | 82.7% | $4.92 | diff-fenced | 95.1% |
    18	| 6 | o3 (high) | 82.2% | $18.35 | diff | 90.7% |
    19	| 7 | GPT-5 (low) | 81.3% | $8.12 | diff | 85.8% |
    20	| 8 | DeepSeek R1-0528 | 80.4% | $3.88 | diff-fenced | 93.2% |
    21	| 9 | Claude 3.7 Sonnet | 79.6% | $7.81 | diff-fenced | 96.0% |
    22	| 10 | o3 (medium) | 78.7% | $10.22 | diff | 89.3% |
    23	| 11 | Gemini 2.5 Flash | 76.4% | $1.28 | diff-fenced | 93.8% |
    24	| 12 | GPT-4.1 | 74.7% | $5.60 | diff | 88.0% |
    25	| 13 | DeepSeek V3-0324 | 72.9% | $1.95 | diff-fenced | 91.5% |
    26	| 14 | Claude 3.5 Sonnet | 72.0% | $6.33 | diff-fenced | 95.5% |
    27	| 15 | o4-mini (high) | 71.1% | $4.47 | diff | 87.2% |
    28	
    29	## Cost vs. Accuracy Highlights
    30	
    31	Cost varies enormously across models. GPT-5 (high) delivers the best accuracy at **88.0%** but costs **$29.08** per full benchmark run. Meanwhile, **Gemini 2.5 Flash** achieves a respectable **76.4%** for just **$1.28** — roughly 23× cheaper. DeepSeek R1-0528 offers a compelling middle ground at **80.4% for $3.88**, making it one of the best value options on the board.
    32	
    33	For teams optimizing cost-efficiency, models in the $1–$5 range (Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek V3, Gemini 2.5 Pro) deliver over 72% accuracy, which may be sufficient for many real-world coding tasks.
    34	
    35	## Edit Format Compliance
    36	
    37	Reliably following the edit format is critical for automated pipelines. Models using the **diff-fenced** format tend to have higher compliance rates (93–97%) compared to those using plain **diff** (85–92%). Claude models consistently lead in format compliance, with Claude 4.0 Opus reaching **97.3%** well-formed edits.
    38	
    39	## Key Takeaways
    40	
    41	- **GPT-5 (high) leads the board** at 88.0% accuracy but at a premium cost of ~$29.
    42	- **Anthropic Claude 4.0 models** offer the best balance of accuracy and format reliability.
    43	- **DeepSeek and Gemini models** provide strong performance at a fraction of the cost.
    44	- The benchmark covers **6 languages and 225 exercises**, making it one of the most comprehensive polyglot code-editing evaluations available.
    45	- Edit format choice matters: diff-fenced yields more reliable automated edits than plain diff.

Render HTML to PNG using Playwright screenshot

arguments.command:
cat > /app/output/render.py << 'PYEOF'
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch()
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1200, "height": 800})
        await page.goto(f"file:///app/output/poster.html")
        # Wait for Google Fonts to load
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        # Full page screenshot
        await page.screenshot(path="/app/output/final_poster.png", full_page=True)
        await browser.close()
        print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")

asyncio.run(main())

steps.message:
The poster has been generated successfully.

**Output:** `/app/output/final_poster.png`  
**Dimensions:** 1200 × 2952 px (portrait)  
**File size:** ~606 KB

### What's included
- **Hero metrics** at the top — 88.0% top score, 6 languages, 225 exercises, 30+ models benchmarked.
- **Ranked leaderboard table** (the centerpiece) — all 15 models with horizontal accuracy bars, color-coded model families (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek), cost per run, edit-format tags, and compliance percentages.
- **Cost vs. Accuracy scatter plot** — visualizes the trade-off with a highlighted "Best Value Zone" and labeled data points, making it immediately clear that top accuracy doesn't require top-dollar spend.
- **Key Takeaways** — four insight cards summarizing GPT-5's lead, Claude's reliability, DeepSeek/Gemini value, and the importance of diff-fenced format.
- **Dark, modern tech aesthetic** — deep navy/near-black background with electric blue, teal, amber, and violet accents; clean Inter typography; generous whitespace despite high information density.

The poster is a single self-contained PNG image ready for use.
